name: The London, New York City
insider_take: A refined Midtown retreat where British elegance meets the electric pulse of New York City — steps from Carnegie Hall and Central Park.
whats_special: The London NYC, part of Marriott's prestigious Luxury Collection, is a sophisticated all-suite hotel nestled in the heart of Midtown Manhattan. Originally designed with a distinctly European sensibility, the hotel offers oversized suites with sweeping city views and interiors that feel more like a private London flat than a traditional hotel room. Its connection to world-class culinary talent and its proximity to 57th Street's famed "Billionaires' Row" make it a standout in one of the world's most competitive hotel markets.
pro_tip: Request a high-floor suite facing west for breathtaking sunset views over Central Park — a perspective that never gets old, no matter how many times you've seen it.
dont_miss: Carnegie Hall is literally steps away — check their calendar before you arrive and book tickets in advance. Also, the hotel's location makes it an ideal base for exploring both Central Park and Fifth Avenue's iconic shopping corridor, all without the need for a cab.
pros: Prime Midtown Manhattan location steps from Central Park and world-class shopping on Fifth Avenue
Generously sized all-suite accommodations offering exceptional space and residential-style comfort rare for New York City
Refined British-inspired elegance with sophisticated interior design and upscale amenities throughout
Part of The Luxury Collection under Marriott STARS, unlocking exclusive perks and elevated recognition for loyalty members
Acclaimed dining and culinary experiences reflecting the hotel's commitment to world-class gastronomy
cons: Midtown Manhattan setting means bustling urban energy with significant street noise and foot traffic
Premium luxury positioning comes with a higher nightly rate compared to standard NYC accommodations
